inventory.notes: Four pieces in one file. (1) juggler: JugglerSendMouseEvent (new, about 45 lines) with a plain static counter sJugglerEventId. (2) juggler: JugglerSendDragEvent (new, about 60 lines) dispatches WidgetDragEvent directly and sets the drag session action from the modifier keys (B212). (3) spoof, input-event-birth: SendWheelEvent gets aLatency and sets mTimeStamp (same hunk as the signature change). (4) spoof, feature canvas-noise-as-drawn: CanvasToDataSourceSurface now passes SFE_AS_DRAWN (our flag, layout/base/nsLayoutUtils.h:2392, handled at nsLayoutUtils.cpp:7452) so the browser's own reader gets the canvas without the canvas noise; it belongs with the nsLayoutUtils change, not with the Juggler input feature (call site now at nsDOMWindowUtils.cpp:1539). The two new methods can move wholesale to our file, leaving one-line XPCOM methods. JugglerSendMouseEvent's last input (aLatency) replaced aDisablePointerEvent, per the comment in the diff.

verifier.why: The unverified claim about SFE_AS_DRAWN is resolved: it is our canvas-noise bypass flag.

inventory.notes: B288: a drag gesture started by a Juggler press continues only with Juggler moves, so native moves during a Juggler press no longer start a native drag. The early return skips only the gesture update; the move is still dispatched (per the comment). Relies on WidgetMouseEvent::mJugglerEventId, defined outside this group (MouseEvents.h, not checked). VERIFIED: WidgetMouseEvent::mJugglerEventId is defined at widget/MouseEvents.h:249.
